business_summary: SMS Co., Ltd. provides information infrastructure for the nursing care, medical care, career, healthcare, and elderly care field business areas in Japan and internationally. The company provides career services, such as Web community for nurses/nursing students and Job information for nursing students; recruiting agent service(RAG) for nurses, midwives, radiological and medical technologists, clinical engineers, public health nurses, registered dietitians, care workers, PT/OT/ST, childcare workers, therapists, care managers, social workers, and disability care workers; workplace assessment tool for nurses; school for workers in the elderly care field; information service on qualification courses for elderly care; media platform; cross-occupational direct recruiting; scholarship information for high school students/nursing students; and web community for registered dietitians. It also offers elderly/disability care services, such as management support for elderly/disability care operators, information portal for the management of home-visit nursing care operators and elderly care operators, research and information on the aging society, and business support for disability care operators; and healthcare services offers remote specific and industrial health services, remote preventive solution for lifestyle-related diseases, RAG for persons with disabilities, information portal of industrial health service, stress checks specialized for medical care and elderly care industries, and solution for balancing work with family care. In addition, the company offers senior life services such as web community for people struggling with elderly care and care managers, referral service of renovation operators, housing for the elderly, home-delivered meals, funeral companies; RAG for construction and real estate industry; and medical information for healthcare professionals. SMS Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: SMS Co., Ltd.는 일본 및 국제적으로 간호, 의료, 경력, 의료 및 노인 간호 분야 사업 분야에 대한 정보 인프라를 제공합니다. 회사는 간호사/간호대학생을 위한 웹 커뮤니티, 간호대학생을 위한 취업정보 등 취업 서비스를 제공합니다. 간호사, 조산사, 방사선 및 의료 기술자, 임상 엔지니어, 공중 보건 간호사, 등록 영양사, 간병인, PT/OT/ST, 보육사, 치료사, 치료 관리자, 사회복지사 및 장애인 간병인을 위한 모집 대리인 서비스(RAG); 간호사를 위한 직장 평가 도구; 노인 간호 분야 근로자를 위한 학교; 노인요양 자격과정 정보 서비스; 미디어 플랫폼; 직업 간 직접 모집; 고등학생/간호학생을 위한 장학금 정보; 등록된 영양사를 위한 웹 커뮤니티입니다. 또한, 노인·장애인 돌봄사업자 경영지원, 방문간호사업자 및 노인돌봄사업자 관리정보포털, 고령사회에 관한 연구·정보, 장애인 돌봄오페라 사업지원 등 노인·장애인 돌봄 서비스도 제공한다.
